x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      BEMS
      or stemmed "HVAC flexibility"
      or stemmed "active building"
      or stemmed "building energy management system"
      or stemmed "building thermal flexibility"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive building"
      or stemmed "grid-interactive efficient building"
      or stemmed "smart building"
    )
    and (
      HIL or stemmed "case study" or stemmed "hardware-in-the-loop"
      or stemmed "market participation" or stemmed "real-world data"
      or demonstration or experiment or field or pilot
    )
    and (
      stemmed "ancillary service"
      or stemmed "fast frequency response"
      or stemmed "frequency regulation"
      or stemmed "frequency response"
      or reserve
    )
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:BEMS|%22HVAC flexibility%22|%22active building%22|%22building energy management system%22|%22building thermal flexibility%22|%22grid-interactive building%22|%22grid-interactive efficient building%22|%22smart building%22,fulltext.search:HIL|%22case study%22|%22hardware-in-the-loop%22|%22market participation%22|%22real-world data%22|demonstration|experiment|field|pilot,fulltext.search:%22ancillary service%22|%22fast frequency response%22|%22frequency regulation%22|%22frequency response%22|reserve&per_page=10
